mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and housing starts indicates increased demand, leading to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising retail sales and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 3% indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production indicates decreased supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of decreasing industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% and a decrease in payroll employment indicate a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment and decreasing payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP indicates decreased demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of negative GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).
